notes:
Two additions to the **Miro export**, both aimed at the same thing: getting a sitemap out of Transmission and onto a board you'd actually show someone.

**Connector thickness** joins the Appearance controls. The lines *between* boxes were always hairlines, which disappear once a sitemap is on a projector or printed for a wall. Pick Thin, Medium, Heavy or Extra heavy; the choice is remembered per project like the connector style and card settings. Thin is the default and matches every export you've made so far, so nothing changes unless you change it.

**Delete board** now appears on the "Exported N pages…" message when an export creates a board. The export dialog has always nudged you toward making a fresh board, reviewing it, and tidying up afterwards — but there was no way to do the tidying, so throwaway boards piled up in your Miro team. It asks you to confirm, and Miro moves the board to your team's trash, so it can be brought back. It only ever offers this for boards the export just created, never one you picked from the list — those may have other work on them.
